chunks: And Zurarah asked Abā Ja‘far عليه السلام:
About a cushion on which there is janābah: may one perform salat (prayer) on it in the litter? He said: “There is no harm in performing salat (prayer) on it.”

key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurarah, the narrator who asked the Imam
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on a cushion associated with janabah while in a carriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning performing salat (prayer) on a cushion associated with janabah while in a mahmil. Imam Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام states that there is no harm in praying on it, indicating permissibility in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.738 – Zurarah asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a cushion (shadhakunah) that may have come into contact with major ritual impurity (janabah) and whether it is permissible to pray on it while it is in a carriage (mahmil).
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in praying on it."
